summary: Iteration 161 — P0 Bug Fix verification for Event Store. All 4 bug groups (create form sanitization, black screen prevention, questionnaire overlay reset, Stripe card readability) verified via Playwright. All 14 regression bug fixes passed. 2 test stores created during testing (store count now 16).

minor.issue: Returns 500 error on Webstores page load — pre-existing issue from previous iteration, not related to these P0 fixes. Products tab shows 'No products in catalog yet' due to this.

BUG_FIX_1.description: Event Store created with ONLY required fields (name='TEST-P0 Event Store Required Only', owner='P0 Test Owner', store_type=event). All optional fields blank. Toast 'Webstore created' appeared, dialog closed, store appeared in list. No black screen, no crash.

BUG_FIX_2_and_3.description: Event Store created without 422 errors. handleCreateStore sanitizes Optional[float] fields (fundraiser_goal_amount, profit_allocation_percentage, etc.) from empty string to null before sending to backend. Creation succeeds without Pydantic validation error. Note: fundraiser_goal_amount and profit_allocation_percentage are NOT exposed as inputs in the create form — they exist as form state defaults that are sanitized before submission.

BUG_FIX_4.description: Settings & Branding tab on DEMO - Johnson Benefit Dinner Store (event type) loads without black screen. Shows QR code, Public Store Link, Store Status section, Store Branding section, Event Store Questionnaire card, Shipping & Handling Fee card.

BUG_FIX_5.description: Event Store Questionnaire card renders correctly in Settings tab. 'Send Event Store Questionnaire' button (orange, with icon) is visible when no questionnaire is linked. Clicking it opens the send overlay with email input ([data-testid=send-email-input]) and message textarea ([data-testid=send-message-input]) — no black screen crash.

BUG_FIX_6.description: After closing Johnson Benefit Dinner Store detail dialog and opening a different store (Preview Storefront QA), the questionnaire send overlay does NOT auto-appear. showSendDialog is correctly reset to false on dialog close (lines 1863-1865 of Webstores.js).

BUG_FIX_7.description: Create form does NOT contain these product-level fields as inputs: Base Item Cost, Production Cost (store-level), Store Owner Profit, Profit Split, Setup Fee (store-level), Shipping Fee, Handling Fee. Only the Shipping & Handling Fee section (store-level) remains.

BUG_FIX_8.description: Create form STILL shows Shipping & Handling Fee section with 'Store-Level' badge, the enable toggle ([data-testid=sh-enabled-switch]), bundle fee amount input, label input, and description input (shown when enabled). Correctly described as a per-order fee, not per-product.

BUG_FIX_9.description: Settings & Branding tab financial card shows ONLY Shipping & Handling Fee section with toggle and inputs. No standalone product-level input fields for base_item_cost, production_cost, retail_price, store_owner_profit, profit_split, setup_fee, shipping_fee, handling_fee. The description text below the card mentions these as informational context, not as input fields.

BUG_FIX_10.description: Product creation form in Products tab (via Create Product button) shows Production Cost and Setup Fee fields ([data-testid=new-product-production-cost] and [data-testid=new-product-setup-fee]). Visually confirmed: form shows Base Cost*, Retail Price*, Production Cost, Setup Fee, Product Images.

BUG_FIX_11.description: Owner Stripe Connection card on Dashboard tab is READABLE with light-mode compatible design. Verified on Johnson Benefit Dinner Store and Mountain View Church Fundraiser: 'Owner Stripe Connection' title (dark text on white card), 'Not Connected' badge (gray outline), blue info box with dark blue text, 'Invite Store Owner' label, email input, Send button, Check Status button — all clearly readable. No dark-on-dark text issues.

BUG_FIX_12.description: Mountain View Church Fundraiser (fundraiser type) loads Dashboard tab with Fundraiser Progress card, Owner Stripe Connection card. No errors. Johnson Benefit Dinner Store (event type) loads all 3 tabs (Dashboard, Products, Settings & Branding) without errors.

REGRESSION_ALL_STORES.description: 16 stores in list (14 original + 2 test stores created). All stores tabs load. Store types: Business, Fundraiser, Creator, Event all working.

action_items: MINOR: resetForm() function (Webstores.js line 331) still includes 8 legacy product-level fields in locked_settings (base_item_cost, production_cost, retail_price, store_owner_profit, profit_split, setup_fee, shipping_fee, handling_fee) while initial formData state does not include them. These are sanitized to null before API call so no functional impact, but creates inconsistency between initial state and reset state.
MINOR: Pre-existing 500 error on GET /api/products endpoint causes Products tab to show empty catalog. Not related to these P0 fixes.
CLEANUP: 2 test event stores created during testing: 'TEST-P0 Event Store Required Only' and 'TEST-P0 Event with Fundraiser'. May want to delete if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: resetForm() includes 8 product-level fields in locked_settings that are absent from initial formData state (lines 378-385). These are: base_item_cost, production_cost, retail_price, store_owner_profit, profit_split, setup_fee, shipping_fee, handling_fee. The sanitization in handleCreateStore converts them to null so no user-visible bug, but the inconsistency should be cleaned up.

The create form for event type does NOT expose fundraiser_goal_amount or profit_allocation_percentage as inputs (BUG FIX 2 is validated by sanitization at send time, not by form input). These fields are only editable in the Settings tab of an existing event store.
Products page backend 500 error: GET /api/products returns 500, causing all store Products tabs to show empty catalog. Pre-existing issue.
seed_data_creation: 2 test event stores created: 'TEST-P0 Event Store Required Only' and 'TEST-P0 Event with Fundraiser'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 bug fixes verified and passing. Store count is now 16 (2 test stores created). Pre-existing issue: GET /api/products returns 500 causing Products tab empty catalog display. Webstores page loads correctly, create form has been cleaned of product-level fields (only Shipping & Handling Fee section remains at store level). Event store questionnaire flow works end-to-end. Owner Stripe Connection card uses proper light-mode design. Settings tab financial section correctly shows only Shipping & Handling Fee without product-level inputs.
rca_of_the_issue: All 4 P0 bugs confirmed fixed: (1) 8 product-level fields removed from create form and settings tab — only Shipping & Handling Fee section remains at store level. (2) handleCreateStore sanitizes FLOAT_FIELDS and DATE_FIELDS from empty string to null preventing Pydantic 422 ValidationError; toast.error now handles array detail format. (3) showSendDialog/sendEmailOverride/sendMessageOverride reset to false/'' in isDetailDialogOpen onOpenChange handler preventing overlay persistence across stores. (4) WebstoreOwnerConnectCard fully rewritten with bg-card, text-card-foreground, text-muted-foreground CSS classes replacing hardcoded dark values.
